relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Build of Quarkus 3.2.6.SP1 is a part of the Red Hat Build of Quarkus Platform release 3.2.6.SP1.

Red Hat Build of Quarkus Platform 3.2.6.SP1 integrates the following Red Hat products:
- Red Hat Build of Quarkus 3.2.6.SP1
- Red Hat Build of Apache Camel for Quarkus 3.2.0

The release of Red Hat Build of Quarkus 3.2.6.SP1 was necessary to record and publish information related to compatibility with Red Hat Build of Apache Camel for Quarkus 3.2.0 and does not include any bug fixes or enhancements compared to the previous 3.2.6.GA release.
